# Captured 2026-10-30 on macOS arm64 (c3c 0.8.1, Flight SQL driver 1.12.0)
# against a local memory daemon on a non-default port:
#
#   export DUCKBOX_HANDLE_SECRET=duckbox-dev-secret
#   ./build/duckbox serve --daemon ./daemons/memory.yaml \
#     --listen 127.0.0.1:47471 --internal-listen 127.0.0.1:48471 --no-metrics
#   ./build/duckbox sandbox create --url grpc://127.0.0.1:47471 \
#     --spec ./policies/memory/analyst.yaml --id acme-analyst --key tenant_21:user_sergio
#   ./build/duckbox sandbox create --url grpc://127.0.0.1:47471 \
#     --spec ./policies/memory/analyst.yaml --id acme-kim --key tenant_22:user_kim
#   make -C examples/c3-adbc
#   export DUCKBOX_URL=grpc://127.0.0.1:47471

$ ./build/query
id	title	amount
1	alpha deal	100
# exit 0

$ DUCKBOX_SANDBOX=acme-kim ./build/query
id	title	amount
3	bravo deal	500
4	bravo two	50
# exit 0

$ DUCKBOX_SQL='SELECT count(*) AS n FROM deals' ./build/query
n
1
# exit 0

$ DUCKBOX_SQL='SELECT * FROM secrets' ./build/query
ExecuteQuery: [FlightSQL] table not allowlisted: memory.main.secrets (InvalidArgument; ExecuteQuery)
# exit 1
